literal_source_claim: 周期解不存在性 (nonexistence of periodic solutions)
domain_and_universes: Open: an exact source must fix the planar domain, its regularity and topology, the vector field and Dulac multiplier regularity, and the solution/flow model.
conclusion: Open: the repository does not say whether the conclusion excludes periodic trajectories, closed orbits contained in a domain, or how boundary and equilibrium cases are treated.

candidate_scope_not_credited.domain: a simply connected open subset D of the real plane
candidate_scope_not_credited.dynamics: an autonomous planar vector field F with enough differentiability for solutions and divergence
candidate_scope_not_credited.multiplier: a continuously differentiable scalar Dulac function B on D
candidate_scope_not_credited.sign_condition: divergence of B F has one strict sign, or one weak sign with a nonvanishing exception condition, throughout D
candidate_scope_not_credited.candidate_conclusion: no nonconstant periodic orbit of x' = F(x) is contained in D

degenerate_cases_to_resolve: divergence identically zero on an open set or almost everywhere
periodic curves touching the domain boundary
nonsimply-connected domains and bounds on the number of cycles
